visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with red-tinted hair wearing a grey and black checkered cardigan holds a ginger and white cat in her lap. The cat looks forward with its ears slightly back. A hand enters from the right holding a white treat sachet. Large white text "挑戰剪指甲" is centered in the frame. The background is an indoor living room with soft lighting. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the orange cat's white paw. A hand holding silver metal clippers carefully trims one of the claws. Simultaneously, another hand feeds the cat from the white treat sachet. The cat is distracted, licking the sachet content. The text "剪" appears next to the clippers. (3) The scene cuts to a white and grey cat. A hand holds its front paw while silver clippers trim a nail. The cat's face is focused on the treat stick being squeezed into its mouth. The background remains the neutral-colored indoor environment. Text "剪" appears on screen. (4) The scene cuts to a tortoiseshell cat with bright orange eyes. The cat licks the treat stick very rapidly with its tongue sticking out. A hand holds the cat's paw while clipping the nails. The cat appears calm but highly focused on the food. (5) A brown tabby cat is shown in a tight close-up, intensely licking the top of the treat stick. Multiple text overlays of the character "剪" appear around the cat's head in a fast sequence, indicating multiple nails being clipped quickly. The lighting is bright and natural. (6) The brown tabby cat finishes licking and pulls its head back, looking away from the camera. The person's hands are visible, still holding the partially empty silver and white treat sachet. The background is slightly blurred, showing a window and indoor furniture. (7) A person's hand holds the treat stick up towards the camera. In the background, a wooden cat climbing wall with shelves is visible. A calico cat sits on one of the higher shelves looking down. Two lines of text appear at the bottom: "-好味貓肉泥條- 你剪指甲的好夥伴!". (8) The video ends with a solid pink screen. Centered in white text are the words "好味小姐" with "LADY FLAVOR" written in a smaller font underneath. The composition is clean and minimalist.
